_comment: ADR 0230. What the in-game 'Informacje' screen (game/Assets/_Project/UI/Resources/About/attributions.txt) must show. rows: number in the docs/LICENSES.md summary table ('Tabela zbiorcza źródeł') -> exact substrings that must be VISIBLE (not in '#' comments). Every row whose 'Wymagana atrybucja' starts with 'tak'/'j.w.' or names a licence text, and whose 'W buildzie' is not 'nie', must be listed here. always_visible: licence names and URLs required by ODbL 4.3 and CC BY / CC BY-SA 3(a)(1)(c). Read by tools/licenses/tests/test_attributions.py and tools/about-runner/Tests/LicensesCompletenessTests.cs.
